Lines.en: Crisis averted, hopefully Dave won't touch any more neon-colored frogs.
Why is everything funny-looking always bad?
That's called aposematism. It's a survival strategy where poisonous prey have bright colors to deter and warn predators.
I didn't ask for a biology lesson!
You did ask, just 10 seconds ago.
Well, I want to leave this crazy-looking jungle with crazy-looking frogs!

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots large peas at the enemies
Blocks zombies and produces more sun
Quickly flings stunning butter at zombies
Shoots mighty lasers down the lane
Spreads by shooting spores at zombies
Rolls bouncing, explosive shots that redirect when hitting a zombie
Eats and blocks zombies, producing sun for each zombie eaten
